materialFindings: A prior-maximum return time of 35-50% requires composite re-clear speed 2.00-2.86x, not 1.8-2.2x.
The stated D10 center was not derivable because the standard purchase power denominator was undefined.
The next simulation required a versioned manifest for cats, helpers, enemies, shops, Dawn, decisions, personas, rounding and seeds.
First-district combat, transition and decision time needed separate distribution targets.
Foreground progression, touch-active time and wall-clock time were conflated.
Dawn needed an objective execution policy and a set-difference permanent reward ledger.
The offline U index needed deterministic, build-independent, clamped inputs and repeated-return tests.
Build spread formulas, recommended-band one-hit scope, and next-level cost semantics needed exact definitions.
Weapon 1.40/1.00/0.80 modifiers needed compatible TTK bands and a separate defensive Guardian formula.
